name: add-to-sequence
description: Adds (enrolls) 1 to 100 contacts saved in your Apollo team in a sequence, sending from one of the team's email accounts. The sequence id comes from apollo__list-sequences, the contact ids from apollo__search-contacts and the email account id from apollo__list-email-accounts. Apollo skips by default contacts with no email, contacts active in or finished with another sequence, and a second contact of a company already in it; the four include flags change that. Spends no Apollo credits; the sequence then emails the contacts on its own schedule.

emailAccountId.description: Apollo email account ID from apollo__list-email-accounts.

includeContactsWithoutEmail.description: Include contacts that do not have an email address.

includeContactsActiveInOtherSequences.description: Include contacts active in other sequences.

includeContactsFinishedInOtherSequences.description: Include contacts that finished other sequences.

includeSameCompany.description: Include contacts from a company already represented in this sequence.
